discordPostHtml:
Hey everyone! I've put together an English translation of Foundation Of Borken by Originem (concept & art by BZone, Apu, Monde, Ura, Mimeio, assembly help by Scythe).

A few important notes:

  • The translation was done with the help of AI, so some lines may read a little rough or miss context. Feedback and corrections are very welcome!
  • I haven't fully tested it for stability yet — it should be playable, but treat it as a work-in-progress.
  • I have Originem's permission (given directly on Discord) to post this English version.

Requirements: Starsector 0.98a-RC8, and the following libraries — LazyLib, MagicLib, and GraphicLib (make sure GraphicLib's enableShaders is set to true for the full visual experience).

All credit for the mod itself goes to Originem and the original team — I only handled the translation. Hope this lets more people enjoy their work!

Download: https://mega.nz/file/8kBzlD6J#ueGGhJeHlzoNLY9qTF8eUVnGpU_4_uRAOT-cpyWwPRE
Alternative download: https://www.mediafire.com/file/450cwyprnogh21w/Foundation+Of+Borken.rar/file
